Camp Hill High School Marching Band


Camp Hill High School, Camp Hill, PA
camphill.band

2026 Fall Program

An Eye for an Eye

"An Eye for an Eye" is our love-letter to "spaghetti westerns" by director Sergio Leone. Taking inspiration from classics such as "The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly," and "A Fistful of Dollars," we are excited to take the audience through a story of betrayal and revenge.

Enjoy our 2026 production as we take you on a journey to the lawless west.

Musical Selections

The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly - Ennio Morricone
The Ecstasy of Gold - Ennio Morricone
A Duel in the Sun - Dimitri Tiomkin
Back to Black - Amy Winehouse
